name: Coupossum
description: Search current coupon codes, deals and products on sale from thousands of online stores. Built on Feedico data. It is not an official Feedico server.
author: Coupossum

tools.name: search_coupons
tools.title: Search coupon codes and deals
tools.description: Find current coupon codes and deals (offers without a code, e.g. free shipping) by keyword and/or store name, optionally for one country. A keyword also matches store names, so "vpn" finds NordVPN. Returns up to 10 active offers (at most 3 per store unless a store is given) with code (or none), end date, countries and links, and says when there are more. Covers coupon codes and deals, not individual products on sale.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. CH or US. Returns offers for that country plus worldwide ones.

tools.name: search_stores
tools.title: Search stores
tools.description: Find stores by name or domain. Returns up to 10 stores with their number of current offers and links, and says when there are more.

tools.name: get_store_offers
tools.title: Get a store's current offers
tools.description: List one store's current coupon codes and deals, soonest ending first, optionally for one country. Returns up to 10 offers with code (or none), end date, countries and links, plus the store's total number of offers and a link to all of them on Coupossum.

store.description: Store name, domain or Coupossum store slug

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. CH or US. Returns offers for that country plus worldwide ones.

tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search products on sale
tools.description: Find individual products currently on sale by keyword, optionally with a maximum price, currency and country. Returns up to 10 products with sale price, regular price, ship-to countries and links, and says when there are more. Covers products on sale, not coupon codes.

currency.description: ISO currency, e.g. USD, EUR, CHF

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. CH or US. Returns offers for that country plus worldwide ones.

prompts.name: store_coupons
prompts.title: Coupon codes for a store
prompts.description: Ask for the current coupon codes and deals of one store.

arguments.name: store
arguments.description: Store name or domain, e.g. "Nike" or "nike.com"

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: Optional ISO country code, e.g. DE or US

prompts.name: products_on_sale
prompts.title: Products on sale
prompts.description: Ask for products currently on sale, optionally under a maximum price.

arguments.name: product
arguments.description: What you are looking for, e.g. "running shoes"

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: Optional ISO country code, e.g. DE or US
